references.text: Mount Hor is also mentioned in connection with Israel's journey through the wilderness, where Aaron died.
Ezekiel describes the northern border of the promised land in his vision of the future distribution of the land.
The Great Sea (the Mediterranean) is mentioned as the boundary for the inheritance of the tribe of Judah.
Continuation of the description of the northern border, from Mount Hor to Lebo-Hamat.
Zebulun's border by the sea is mentioned in Jacob's blessing, pointing toward the future territories of the tribes.
